```{r}
source("setup.R")
```

```{r}
fc_ws <- read_csv("data/FCws_WR417_2026.csv")

fc_class <- read_csv("data/WR417 Precipitation Measurements 2026 - Datasheet.csv")

class_meta <- read_csv("data/WR417 Precipitation Measurements 2026 - Metadata.csv")
```

```{r}
fc_class_tidy <- fc_class |>
  transmute(
    sheet_row = row_number() + 1,  
    site = str_squish(Location_name),
    date = mdy(str_replace(Date, "20206$", "2026")),  
    time_obs = Time,
    is_trace = P_in %in% "T" | P_mm %in% "T",
    P_in = if_else(P_in %in% "T", 0, parse_double(P_in, na = c("", "NA", "T"))),
    P_mm_reported = parse_double(P_mm, na = c("", "NA", "T")),
    quality = Quality,
    weather = Weather,
    comments = Comments,
    source = "class"
  )

fc_class_tidy |>
  summarize(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_sites = n_distinct(site),
    n_bad_dates = sum(is.na(date)),
    n_trace = sum(is_trace),
    n_missing_P_in = sum(is.na(P_in)),
    first_date = min(date, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_date = max(date, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
fc_name <- "Fort Collins Weather Station"

fc_ws_tidy <- fc_ws |>
  transmute(
    site = fc_name,
    date = mdy(date),
    P_in,
    is_trace = FALSE,
    source = "fc_station"
  )

precip_all <- bind_rows(fc_class_tidy, fc_ws_tidy) |>
  arrange(site, date, time_obs)

station_summary <- precip_all |>
  group_by(site) |>
  summarize(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_days = n_distinct(date),
    first_date = min(date),
    last_date = max(date),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

nrow(precip_all)
station_summary |> print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}
class_meta_tidy <- class_meta |>
  transmute(
    site = Location_name |> str_remove_all('"') |> str_squish(),
    site = case_when(
      site == "Cloth Sample" ~ "Cloth sample",
      site == "Lake Street" ~ "Lake Landing",  # assumption: confirm this match
      site == "FOCO_Station_CSU" ~ fc_name,
      .default = site
    ),
    lat = Lat,
    lon = -abs(Long),  # FC station was entered as +105.09; Colorado longitudes are negative
    am_pm = str_to_upper(`AM or PM measurments`),
    gauge = str_squish(Gauge),
    units = str_squish(Units),
    precision = Precision,
    height_above_ground = `Height above ground (ft)`,
    opening_area = `Opening area (in^2)`,
    install_comments = Install_comments
  )

stations <- class_meta_tidy |>
  left_join(
    station_summary |> select(site, n_days, first_date, last_date),
    by = "site"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    source = if_else(site == fc_name, "fc_station", "class"),
    has_data = !is.na(n_days)
  )

# Should return 0 rows: sites in the data with no metadata match
station_summary |>
  anti_join(class_meta_tidy, by = "site")

# Should return 0 rows: stations with missing or out-of-state coordinates
stations |>
  filter(is.na(lat) | is.na(lon) | !between(lat, 37, 41) | !between(lon, -109.05, -102.05))

# Should return 1 row: Howes St. Waterfall
stations |>
  filter(!has_data) |>
  select(site, lat, lon)

nrow(stations)
```

```{r}
stations_fc <- stations |>
  filter(site != "Leadville 0.2 NW") |>
  mutate(point_color = if_else(source == "fc_station", "green", "navy"))

station_map <- leaflet(stations_fc) |>
  #addTiles() |>
  #addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldGrayCanvas) |>
  #addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldTopoMap) |>
  addTiles(options = tileOptions(opacity = 0.5)) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lon,
    lat = ~lat,
    color = ~point_color,
    radius = 5,
    stroke = FALSE,
    fillOpacity = 0.9,
    label = ~site
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    colors = c("navy", "green"),
    labels = c("Class Station", "Fort Collins Weather Station"),
    opacity = 0.9
  ) |>
  addScaleBar(position = "bottomleft")

station_map
```
